grammars.name: sgconf
grammars.title: Surge Configuration Language
grammars.content-regex: (?m)^[ \t]*(?:#!(?:MANAGED-CONFIG|FORBIDDEN-AUTO-UPGRADE|REQUIREMENT|IOS-ONLY|MACOS-ONLY|TVOS-ONLY|include)(?:[ \t]|$)|#!(?:name|desc|system|arguments|requirement)=|\[(?:Proxy Group|Rule|URL Rewrite|Header Rewrite|Body Rewrite|Map Local|MITM|SSID Setting|Port Forwarding|Snell Server|MTProto)\][ \t]*\r?$|\[(?:WireGuard|Tailscale|Ruleset)[ \t]+)

metadata.description: Tree-sitter grammar for Surge configuration documents
